name: Haystack Pipelines + Weaviate + FastAPI (Hayhooks)
note: Every task runs a real command. The starter's Weaviate layer is its own in-memory store (the interface the pipeline calls), and no LLM is wired in, so no Weaviate server or model is needed. Tenant isolation is therefore verified against that in-memory store, not against a live Weaviate tenant. The Haystack DAG itself is real (haystack-ai). Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Explicit Haystack DAG and health probes
eval_tasks.instruction: The retrieval DAG must be wired explicitly, the retriever must refuse to run without a tenant, and the health probe must reflect real component state.
assertions: retriever.documents is explicitly connected to prompt_builder.documents
the retriever declares typed output sockets
retrieval without a tenant raises
health is healthy normally and degraded when Weaviate or the pipeline is not ready
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "dag or retriever or health" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Tenant-partitioned hybrid search
eval_tasks.instruction: Hybrid search must be partitioned per tenant, tenant must be mandatory with a restricted format, and weak candidates must be rejected.
assertions: tenant A never retrieves tenant B chunks over HTTP and vice versa
the same document id in two tenants does not collide
search, index and the HTTP schemas all reject a missing tenant
tenant ids containing spaces, quotes, traversal or newlines are rejected
candidates below the 0.40 fused-score floor are dropped
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "tenant or hybrid or fused or partitioned" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Faithfulness gate and prompt-injection boundary
eval_tasks.instruction: Answers below the 0.85 faithfulness threshold must be withheld, and retrieved chunks must be delimited as untrusted data they cannot escape.
assertions: the groundedness threshold is 0.85
an ungrounded answer is replaced by a refusal and a grounded one is returned
the eval endpoint flags a hallucinated answer
each chunk sits in its own delimited block and cannot close it
document ids cannot inject markup into the block header
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "faith or groundedness or ungrounded or grounded or eval_endpoint or evaluator or prompt or block or markup" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: CORS, input limits, error hygiene and container hardening
eval_tasks.instruction: A wildcard CORS origin must never be honoured, bodies must be size-bounded, errors must not leak internals, Weaviate must not be published to the host, and the image must run non-root.
assertions: a wildcard origin is dropped and unlisted origins get no allow header
oversized or malformed bodies are rejected with 422
pipeline failures return a generic 500
the weaviate compose service publishes no ports and the app targets its internal port
the final Dockerfile stage drops to a numeric UID >= 10000
credential-named keys in .env.example are empty
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "cors or oversized or generic_500 or published or non_root or env_example" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
assertions: pytest exits 0 across tests/
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
